name: Apollo
alt_names: One of the few Olympians whose name is the same in both Greek and Roman tradition
summary: God of prophecy, light, music, healing, and archery. Twin brother of Artemis, closely associated with the Oracle of Delphi and regarded as a patron of the arts and reason.
domain_role: Prophecy, music, poetry, healing, archery, the sun (in later tradition)
origin_story: Apollo and his twin sister Artemis were born to Zeus and the Titaness Leto, who was forced to wander in search of a place to give birth after the jealous Hera forbade any land from sheltering her. The floating island of Delos finally accepted her, and it became one of Apollo's most sacred sites.
achievements: Slew the serpent Python at Delphi, establishing the site as his own and the seat of his famous Oracle
Presided over the Oracle of Delphi, where the priestess (the Pythia) delivered his prophecies
Regarded as patron of music and poetry, often depicted with a lyre
Fought on the side of Troy during the Trojan War, in opposition to Athena and Hera

signature_quote.note: This maxim reflects Apollo's connection with prophecy, wisdom, and the discipline of understanding one's own limits.
